all_in_one_evidence: Current module map showing which endpoint, service, commercial, and reporting jobs are native
separate_stack_evidence: Current system map showing which product owns each required job
live_test: Run the same representative endpoint alert through triage, service work, customer update, closure, and reporting.

all_in_one_evidence: Evidence that every bundled module supports the required daily workflow—not only that the module exists
separate_stack_evidence: Evidence that each selected product supports its owned workflow and the integrations do not remove required depth
live_test: Time five common technician workflows and record workarounds, duplicate entry, and unsupported steps.

all_in_one_evidence: Documented ownership for customer, site, endpoint, alert, ticket, agreement, time, charge, invoice, and audit records
separate_stack_evidence: Documented system of record and stable cross-system identifier for every shared object
live_test: Change one shared record through the approved path and verify the final value, history, and conflict behavior.

all_in_one_evidence: Native routing, deduplication, recovery, reopen, ownership, and closure evidence
separate_stack_evidence: Connector mappings, retry, replay, deduplication, reconciliation, failure ownership, and closure evidence
live_test: Trigger a confirmed alert, a duplicate, a recovery, an API failure, and a reopen; reconcile both sides.

all_in_one_evidence: Measured navigation, search, handoff, evidence capture, and customer-context time inside the suite
separate_stack_evidence: Measured context switching, deep-link quality, identity handoff, and duplicate-entry time across products
live_test: Have two technicians complete the same five tasks without vendor guidance and compare time and error rate.

all_in_one_evidence: Documented triggers, approvals, privileged actions, rollback, logs, and ticket feedback across native modules
separate_stack_evidence: Documented automation owner plus authenticated handoff, idempotency, rollback, logs, and ticket feedback across tools
live_test: Run one read-only and one authorized reversible automation; prove outcome, attribution, failure, and rollback.

all_in_one_evidence: Complete quote including required modules, technicians, endpoints, minimums, storage, implementation, support, and contract term
separate_stack_evidence: Complete cost for every product plus connectors, middleware, integration support, reconciliation labor, and implementation
live_test: Price the same fleet and required scope at current size, 50% growth, and 25% contraction.

all_in_one_evidence: Measured monthly administration, exception handling, reporting, billing reconciliation, and vendor-management hours
separate_stack_evidence: Measured integration monitoring, exception handling, duplicate entry, reporting, billing reconciliation, and multi-vendor hours
live_test: Track actual administration and reconciliation time during a representative pilot week.

all_in_one_evidence: Documented process and timing for adding and removing endpoints, technicians, modules, and customers
separate_stack_evidence: Documented adjustment terms for every product and connector, including minimums and mismatched billing periods
live_test: Model one customer win, one customer loss, technician turnover, and a temporary project spike.

all_in_one_evidence: Role model, service identities, MFA, tenant boundaries, field visibility, audit attribution, and emergency disable across modules
separate_stack_evidence: Equivalent controls in each system plus scoped integration identities, token rotation, secret storage, and cross-system audit attribution
live_test: Prove a read-only role cannot write, a customer-scoped role cannot cross tenants, and emergency revocation stops access.

all_in_one_evidence: Inventory of internal service boundaries, privileged dependencies, data flows, and vendor-operated connectors
separate_stack_evidence: Inventory of APIs, webhooks, tokens, middleware, network paths, stored secrets, and external processors
live_test: Disable or rotate one integration credential and verify fail-closed behavior, alerts, recovery, and audit evidence.

all_in_one_evidence: Evidence showing whether one module failure degrades the entire suite and how queues, retries, and degraded modes work
separate_stack_evidence: Evidence showing how each product and connector fails, how work continues, and how missed records reconcile
live_test: Simulate an allowed connector or module outage and verify backlog, visibility, recovery, and no silent data loss.

all_in_one_evidence: Report lineage from endpoint and service activity through SLA, time, agreement, invoice, profitability, and customer output
separate_stack_evidence: Cross-system report lineage, extract timing, stable keys, reconciliation rules, and ownership for disputed totals
live_test: Rebuild one customer service report and one profitability view from source records; reconcile every total.

all_in_one_evidence: One accountable support path with severity definitions, escalation targets, module expertise, and evidence preservation
separate_stack_evidence: Named first responder and escalation path for product, connector, mapping, and cross-vendor incidents
live_test: Open a bounded support case about a test integration failure and assess ownership, evidence requests, and resolution quality.

all_in_one_evidence: Suite release calendar, sandbox or preview path, dependency testing, rollback, and notice for breaking changes
separate_stack_evidence: Per-vendor release monitoring plus regression tests for APIs, mappings, workflows, and authentication dependencies
live_test: Review one historical breaking change and run the documented regression test before and after the current version.

all_in_one_evidence: Documented export for endpoint, policy, script, ticket, agreement, time, billing, audit, and configuration records
separate_stack_evidence: Documented export from every product plus mapping records, connector state, stable identifiers, and reconciliation evidence
live_test: Export a representative customer and prove readability, completeness, relationships, timestamps, and ownership.

all_in_one_evidence: Evidence that one weak module can be disabled or replaced without losing required records or supportability
separate_stack_evidence: Evidence that one product can be replaced while the remaining systems continue with bounded coexistence and rollback
live_test: Replace or disconnect one noncritical pilot component; verify retained operations, history, access removal, and recovery.

all_in_one_evidence: Named decision owner, weighted results, stop conditions, unresolved gaps, remediation commitments, and rollout gate
separate_stack_evidence: Named decision owner, weighted results, stop conditions, unresolved gaps, remediation commitments, and rollout gate
live_test: Require the same evidence threshold for both models and record adopt, limited adopt, remediate and retest, or reject.
